collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — ROLE MODELS AND GOOD EXAMPLES, RM-41 to RM-90 (draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Fifty more events continuing your "Role Models and Good Examples — 40 Events". Same shape as yours: a SETUP, choices A-D (a few have three), and two possible outcomes per choice; the game picks one outcome from the chosen choice.

ledger.why: the owner (2026-11-15): the person the event is about is a cast villager shown by name, the role word kept as flavor (the villager need not have that job)

collection.description: A neighbor has been suffering bad headaches, and a builder is about to start a noisy day of pounding posts nearby.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: A neighbor has been suffering bad headaches, and (name1), a builder, is about to start a noisy day of pounding posts nearby.

choices.label: Work Quietly on Other Tasks First.
Ask the Neighbor What Would Help.
Ask Others to Help Finish the Noisy Part Quickly.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: The neighbor rests well and thanks the builder the next day.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: The delay pushes the hut behind schedule, and the builder works harder later.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: The builder carves joints and shapes beams, saving the pounding for later.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: The quiet work runs out quickly, and the builder asks the neighbor when would be best.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: The neighbor plans a visit to a cousin, and the builder works freely while they are gone.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: The neighbor says they will manage, and the builder works in short, quiet bursts anyway.

d1.name: Outcome D1
d1.text: The pounding is done in one short morning, and the neighbor is grateful.

d2.name: Outcome D2
d2.text: The helpers make even more noise than expected, and everyone apologizes.
